{{Quote|He says he spotted some battle droids lurking in the area.|Qui-Gon Jinn, referring to Attichitcuk's sighting of DRN-38's droids|audio=SpottedBattleDroids.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
'''DRN-38''' was an individual who [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a unit in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], DRN-38 was sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], where the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in DRN-38's unit [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambushed]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], nearly [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], later [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescued]] him, destroying many of DRN-38's droids along the way.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Halt. You are ordered to come with us|One of DRN-38's battle droids, to Attichitcuk|audio=BattleDroidHalt.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Itchy-ambush.png|thumb|left|DRN-38's droids caught Attichitcuk in an ambush that nearly cost him his life.]]
DRN-38 was an individual who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the corporation known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] as portrayed in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> DRN-38 [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was sent to the [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] along with a contingent of the Droid [[Army/Legends|Army]] in an illegal colonization attempt. On the moon, DRN-38's droids encountered a small group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] led by the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], who was leading his [[Species/Legends|species]] in a [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|legally authorized]] [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization effort]] on Alaris Prime. One of DRN-38's [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s ordered Attichitcuk to come with them, but when the Wookiee refused to comply, the droids [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|shot]] Attichitcuk's party, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the other Wookiees present and badly wounding the Chieftain.<ref name="SW:GB" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was assisting the Wookiees, sent Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] him. Chewbacca found Attichitcuk, destroying many of DRN-38's droids in the process and, after having a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] heal him, returned the Chieftain to their nearby [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]]. In retaliation, DRN-38 sent three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to the base to which Attichitcuk had been taken, but the Wookiees defeated the droids and went on to [[Battle for Alaris Prime|remove]] the Trade Federation's presence from Alaris Prime.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Personality and traits==
DRN-38 was given command of a unit of droids in the Trade Federation army, which included B1 battle droids and several droidekas.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Warning: Your armies are being attacked by DRN-38!!!|Notification that appears when the player is attacked by DRN-38's droids|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
DRN-38 was mentioned in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The individual's name was given as the commander of the Trade Federation forces in the fourth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Researching technology."<ref name="SW:GB" />
